security.csp: default-src 'self'; connect-src 'self' http://localhost:* ws://localhost:* http://127.0.0.1:* ws://127.0.0.1:*; script-src 'self' 'unsafe-inline'; style-src 'self' 'unsafe-inline' https://fonts.googleapis.com; font-src 'self' https://fonts.gstatic.com; img-src 'self' data: blob:

bundle.shortDescription: Local AI inference for the enterprise.
bundle.longDescription: Foundry Runtime is a desktop application that runs large language models entirely on your hardware. Pick a model from the catalog, run a local inference server with an OpenAI-compatible API, and chat with it through a polished workspace UI. Pro tier unlocks Roundtable mode, premium templates, PowerPoint export, and persistent memory.

windows.signCommand: sign code trusted-signing --azure-credential-type azure-cli --trusted-signing-endpoint https://eus.codesigning.azure.net/ --trusted-signing-account fireside-labs-signing --trusted-signing-certificate-profile foundry-runtime-prod --timestamp-url http://timestamp.acs.microsoft.com %1
